'''Z-Beta Squadron''' was an fighter squadron that defected from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|rogue]] [[Zaarin's fleet|fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It fought at the [[Attack on ZA-13|First Battle of ZA-13]] in the [[Zaarin insurrection]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but were ultimately defeated at the [[Battle of To-phalion Base]].
